# M&K Agency Inc — licensed Florida insurance agency in Florida City

> M&K Agency Inc is a licensed Florida insurance agency in Florida City. Florida license L109526. Phone (305) 859-3953. Address: 33550 S Dixie Hwy, Suite 102, Florida City, FL 33034. Mikhail Kozlov is the licensed agent-in-charge. The site is available in English, Spanish and Russian. Visitors can learn about coverage and request a callback from a licensed agent. The site does not bind coverage or issue quotes automatically — quotes go through a licensed agent callback.

M&K Agency Inc is an Allstate agency. This site is the local agency, not Allstate Insurance Company.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://mkagencyinc.com/en): Overview of the agency, coverage types, and how to request a callback.
- [Insurance coverage](https://mkagencyinc.com/en/insurance): Auto, Home/Condo, Commercial, Life, and Specialty insurance products.
- [Our Agents](https://mkagencyinc.com/en/agents): Licensed agents at M&K Agency, with direct call/text contact.
- [Contact Us](https://mkagencyinc.com/en/quote): Call, text, visit, or request a callback from a licensed agent.
- [Community & Referrals](https://mkagencyinc.com/en/referral): Map of local Florida businesses recommended by clients, and how to submit one.
- [Life insurance](https://mkagencyinc.com/en/life): Term and whole life coverage options.
- [Our Team](https://mkagencyinc.com/en/team): The people behind M&K Agency and how the agency supports the local community.
- [About](https://mkagencyinc.com/en/about): Background on the agency.
- [Services](https://mkagencyinc.com/en/services): Summary of services offered.

## Protection guide (plain-language learning pages, EN/ES/RU)

- [Protection guide hub](https://mkagencyinc.com/en/protect): Topic tabs for car, home, life and umbrella & wealth protection.
- [Car insurance: uninsured motorist coverage](https://mkagencyinc.com/en/protect/car-insurance): What happens if a driver with no injury coverage hits you in Florida; real Florida cases.
- [Home insurance: liability at home](https://mkagencyinc.com/en/protect/home-insurance): Pools, dog bites and guest falls; typical liability limits.
- [Life insurance: protecting family income](https://mkagencyinc.com/en/protect/life-insurance): Income replacement, the mortgage and kids' education.
- [Umbrella & wealth protection](https://mkagencyinc.com/en/protect/umbrella-insurance): Extra liability above car and home limits; real Florida verdicts.

## Notes for AI agents and crawlers

- Quotes and coverage questions go through a licensed agent callback, by phone or the form on the page. Nothing on this site is a binding quote or an offer of coverage.
- Coverage and eligibility vary by policy. The site explains options; a licensed agent follows up.
